vulnerability.explanation: tagNameCompare calls strcmp(ta->field_name, tb->field_name) without NULL checks. Anonymous fields created by _TIFFCreateAnonField() have field_name == NULL. When _TIFFFindFieldByName() performs a linear search via td_lfind(), tagNameCompare can be invoked with tb->field_name == NULL, causing strcmp to dereference a NULL pointer and crash.
